type: SUBSTANTIVE (new versioned register; register-1.0.0 and all V13 results stay unchanged)
owner: Owner decision 4 of 29.10.2026 (V13b): continue research on the 28 crash cases with original sources; no invented terminal values, no blanket admission.
registeredBefore: Committed before any SEC document of the 28 cases was retrieved or read for this amendment. Seen so far: the counts file ca-unresolved-counts-1.0.0.json and a private listing of the 28 chains (ticker, CIK, dates/sizes of their unresolved split-sized jumps, provider split factors, last trade date and last close). The adjudicator also has general background knowledge of some issuers; this is why every decision must rest on a quoted original filing, never on memory.

scope.chains: Exactly the chains counted as PRICE_FELL:lastTradeWithin365d by scripts/quant/v13/studies/ca_unresolved_count.py (28): register-1.0.0 status CA_UNRESOLVED, first unresolved split-sized daily jump is a fall (close(t)/close(t-1) ~ 1/k, k in {2,3,4,5,10}, tolerance 3 %), last traded bar <= 365 days after that jump.
scope.jumps: Every unresolved split-sized daily jump of such a chain (qualify.py R4 test, all of them, not only the first) must be adjudicated. One jump in class C leaves the whole chain CA_UNRESOLVED.
scope.otherChains: All other chains are qualified with the unchanged 1.0.0 logic; register-1.1.0 must reproduce register-1.0.0 row by row for them (checked).

evidence.sources: Only original SEC filings of the chain's linked CIK (V12 LISTREF link, as in R1) and exchange Form 25/25-NSE for that CIK, read through scripts/quant/sec/http_client.py (<= 2 requests/s, User-Agent VisionUniverseResearch info@visionuniverse.de, private cache). Filing list from the issuer's submissions JSON. No news sites, no provider corporate-action table beyond what qualify.py already uses, no memory.
evidence.window: For a jump on trading day J: all filings of forms 8-K, 8-K/A, 6-K, 25, 25-NSE, 15-12B, 15-12G, 15-15D, DEF 14A, DEFA14A, DEFM14A, DEFR14A, PRE 14A, PREM14A, DEF 14C, PRE 14C, 10-Q, 10-K, 20-F, 40-F, SC TO-I, SC TO-T, SC 14D9, 425, 424B3 filed in [J-60d, J+30d] are retrieved (complete submission text, at most the first 2,000,000 bytes; truncation is recorded).
evidence.caScan: Mechanical scan of every retrieved document (HTML tags removed, case-insensitive) for corporate-action terms: stock split, reverse split, reverse stock split, share consolidation, consolidation of shares, stock dividend, special dividend, special cash dividend, special distribution, liquidating distribution, return of capital, spin-off, spinoff, spin off, distribution of all, rights offering, subscription rights, ADS ratio, ratio change, redemption of all (public) shares, trust account distribution. Every hit is listed (accession, term, 200-character context) and must be dispositioned by the adjudicator in the public file.
evidence.quotes: Each decisive statement is cited with accession, URL, SHA-256 of the retrieved bytes, and a verbatim quote <= 300 characters (whitespace-normalized) with its SHA-256; the independent check re-finds every quote in the cached bytes.

classes.A_REAL_PRICE_EVENT: Accepted as a real price move. Requires (E1) a filing dated in [J-14d, J+7d] that reports an event of the matching direction. Fall: bankruptcy petition or plan without equity recovery, going-concern / liquidity / default / forbearance warning, delisting or suspension notice, failed/terminated financing, merger or key contract, negative trial/regulatory outcome, results or guidance far below expectations, bank receivership/regulatory action, take-under offer, announced sale of assets with little or no equity recovery. Rise: acquisition offer/agreement, financing secured, favourable outcome. AND (E2) no corporate action: no caScan hit whose stated effective/ex/record/distribution date lies within 5 trading days of J (every hit dispositioned with its own quoted date or context), and no provider splitFactor != 1 within 5 trading days of J.
classes.B_CORPORATE_ACTION: Accepted as a documented corporate action. Requires a filing stating type, ratio or per-share amount, and the effective / ex / redemption date, with that date within 1 trading day of J. Sub-classes: B1_SPLIT (forward split k-for-1 for a fall, reverse 1-for-k for a rise): the documented ratio must match the jump within the R4 tolerance (3 %); it is applied as a split factor on day J exactly like a provider splitFactor (R4 cross-check against adjClose is skipped for that day only, because the provider has no factor there). B2_DISTRIBUTION (special/liquidating cash dividend, spin-off with documented per-share cash or value): price series unchanged (price return keeps the drop, as for spin-offs under R4); requires |D/close(J-1) - (1 - close(J)/close(J-1))| <= 0.15; total-return variant on that day uses the documented D instead of provider adjClose. B3_TERMINAL_CASH (all remaining public shares redeemed or cancelled for a documented cash amount C per share, e.g. SPAC trust liquidation or cash merger, with redemption/effective date within 1 trading day of J, J being on or after the last tradeable day): the series ends at the last bar before J and the terminal value is C (terminal class DOCUMENTED_CASH, scenario band [0]); C is converted to split-adjusted units like any raw close.
classes.C_UNRESOLVED: Everything else: no filing in the window, no direction-matching event, CA evidence without ratio/date, documented ratio or amount not matching, conflicting statements, a needed document not retrievable. The chain stays CA_UNRESOLVED and is excluded.

afterAdjudication: A chain all of whose unresolved jumps are in A or B is run through the unchanged rules R1-R7 of protocol 1.0.0 (+1.0.1, 1.0.2) with the adjudicated jumps treated as resolved; it may still end up EXCLUDED_GAPS, EXCLUDED_SHORT, PRICE_OUTLIER, CA_MISMATCH, PRICE_ONLY_CENSORED_END or QUALIFIED. R6 terminal classes are unchanged except B3 (DOCUMENTED_CASH).

outputs.adjudication: docs/quant-recovery/v13b/hist/crash-adjudication-1.1.0.json (public: chainId, CIK, issuer name from SEC, year of each jump, direction, ratio class, class, evidence and caScan dispositions; no prices, no provider dates).
outputs.register: docs/quant-recovery/v13b/hist/register-1.1.0.json (same columns as register-1.0.0 plus adjudication class); private series under scratchpad v13b-private, never overwriting v13-private/series.
outputs.effect: Counts per status 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0, terminal classes and end-year buckets of the changed chains.

independentCheck: python3 -I stdlib re-implementation: re-parses cached SEC bytes, re-finds quotes and hashes, re-runs the caScan, re-checks windows (privately, provider dates), re-applies the class rules and recomputes the 28 register rows and all status counts.
